humanTitle: People lose the activity they were in the middle of recording
whoItAffects: iPhone users in the United States, across four app versions.

build.proposition: A recorder that writes each location fix to disk as it arrives.
specifics: Append points to a local file rather than holding a session in memory
Offer the partial track back after a crash instead of discarding it
Start with the mid-activity stop reviewers describe
build.limitation: Continuous disk writes cost battery, which is the other thing these reviews complain about.

start.proposition: A recorder whose only job is not to stop.
specifics: Records and exports, and syncs to whatever the person already uses
Sold to people whose activity cannot be repeated
start.limitation: The phone's own health platform already records this, for free, at the system level.

study.proposition: How often does a consumer tracker lose part of a session?
specifics: Run paired devices over the same route and compare recovered tracks
Check whether loss clusters on long sessions or on specific releases
study.limitation: Reproducing a crash that depends on hours of movement is slow and expensive.

write.proposition: The run that did not happen because the app stopped.
specifics: Follow someone whose training log has a hole in it
Quote the reviews describing a stop mid-hike
write.limitation: Fitness-app grumbling is common; the story is what a lost record costs someone in training.
